gaps.brief: Evaluate commercial_ppo medical amount_cents 0; assert 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
Evaluate medicare_b dental amount_cents 100000 active false; assert inactive denial takes precedence.
Evaluate medicare_advantage hospital amount_cents 100000 in_network false authorized false; assert network denial precedes authorization.
Evaluate medicare_d prescription amount_cents 100000 formulary false; assert NON_FORMULARY and zero payout.
Evaluate commercial_ppo medical amount_cents 10001; assert approved payout exactly 1 cent.
Evaluate commercial_ppo medical amount_cents 210001; assert approved payout capped at 200000.
Submit an M100 medical claim as customer-m100, then reject customer-m200 read with 403; owner reads unchanged evidence.
Submit an M100 claim, repeat the same ID with 409 DUPLICATE_CLAIM, then owner reads unchanged full evidence.
Submit an M100 claim then finance attempts paid before approval, expect 409; owner reads unchanged full evidence.
M100 medical amount 9999: submit, adjuster approve, finance pay, owner read. Assert payout 0 throughout, null payment before paid then payment 0; revisions/events 1,2,3,3.
M100 medical amount 100000: submit, approve, pay, repeat paid expecting 409, then owner read unchanged payout/payment 90000 and revision/events 3.
